rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The maintainer block's three 'Slide size accepted' notes (lines 181, 183, 185) all rest on the stated premise that 'a supplementary never reaches the composed Slides deck (check_slides.md §10)' and that this file's sections have 'no projected page to be a claim about' / sit 'on a page that never projects.' This premise contradicts the renderer as currently shipped. (1) `site/layouts/curriculum.js:75` registers `skill-stacking` in AE101's `supplementaries` list. (2) `scripts/build-workbook.js:481` (`renderStandalone`) wraps every registered supplementary's rendered body as `<section class="module" id="supplementary-${slug}">...</section>`, and line 485 concatenates it into the same `<main>` as the modules -- i.e. it IS a top-level `section.module`, rule 10's own inclusion criterion. (3) `site/layouts/slides.js:265-347` (`buildDeckModel`): when the composed root has module phases (the normal whole-workbook case), it walks `:scope > section.module` (line 281); a phase-less prose section -- the code's own comment at line 273 names 'prework, supplementary, reference' explicitly -- falls to the `else` branch at line 337-346, which pushes a kind-labelled divider (code 'S1' etc, line 338-345) and then calls `buildSingleDoc(moduleEl, ...)` at line 346, chunking the supplementary's own `##` headings into slides exactly like any other doc. This is precisely the fix the 2026-07-09 compounded entry (`memory/compounded/2026-07-09-student_facing-verify-content-presence-in-both-layouts.md`) describes: 'Fixed the renderer + added scripts/slides.test.js (jsdom) asserting the deck includes prework/supplementary/reference' -- supplementary content used to be dropped (the bug the note's parenthetical describes) and was fixed to be INCLUDED, not fixed to stay excluded. Separately, even a reader landing on this page as a standalone single-doc view (no composed root) hits `buildDeckModel`'s `phases.length === 0` branch (line 265-268), which also chunks the file at `##` via `buildSingleDoc`. Under either path this file's `##` sections do become individual projected slides.
